sentences.text: The animal is known from a single partial skeleton found in Gove County, Kansas, that lacks a skull.
Iaceornis was a marine ornithuran dinosaur closely related to modern birds.
The fossil specimen was first discovered by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1877.
In 2004, Julia A. Clarke distinguished the skeleton from Apatornis based on differences in wing bone characteristics.
Clarke named the new species Iaceornis marshi, which translates to 'Marsh's neglected bird'.
Iaceornis is a genus of dinosaur.
The only known species is Iaceornis marshi.
The genus was named by Clarke in 2004.
Iaceornis lived in North America during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 83.5 million years ago.
The time range for Iaceornis is the Santonian stage, between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago.
